title: A dog's kennel
done: You made a kennel! A dog can sleep inside.

steps.say: Put a yellow square flat on the table. It is the floor.
Stand a red square up on the front.
Stand a red square up on this side.
Stand a red square up on the back.
Stand a red square up on the last side.
Grown-up, help your builder lean four blue triangles in on top. Their corners meet. That is the roof.
